incident_summary: A confidential spreadsheet (m57plan.xlsx) containing M57.biz employee salary and SSN data was posted as an attachment in the technical support forum of a competitor's website. The spreadsheet originated from CFO Jean Jones's computer.

subjects.name: Jean Jones
subjects.statement: Alison asked me to prepare the spreadsheet as part of new funding round. Alison asked me to send the spreadsheet to her by email. That is all I know.

subjects.name: Alison Smith
subjects.statement: I don't know what Jean is talking about. I never asked Jean for the spreadsheet. I never received the spreadsheet by email.

exfiltrated_document.description: M57.biz company spreadsheet containing employee names, roles, salaries, and SSNs

evidence_sources.description: EnCase image of Jean Jones's computer (jeanm57.E01 / jeanm57.aff)
Copy of m57plan.xlsx recovered from competitor website

investigation_questions: When did Jean create the spreadsheet m57plan.xlsx?
How did the document travel from Jean's computer to the competitor's website?
Who else from the company may be involved in the exfiltration?

conflict_of_statements.jean_claims: Alison requested the spreadsheet for the funding round and asked her to email it.
conflict_of_statements.alison_denies: Alison says she never asked for or received the spreadsheet.
conflict_of_statements.conclusion: One of the two parties is lying. Physical disk evidence is required to resolve the conflict.

company_context.name: M57.biz
company_context.description: Virtual web startup developing a body art catalog
